name: Tự Đức
contribution: The fourth emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty of Vietnam, and the country's last pre-colonial monarch.
legacy: This person did not live to see the worst effects of colonialism on his country, and he was also the last Vietnamese monarch to rule independently.
image_credit: The original uploader was Docteur Rieux at Vietnamese Wikipedia. · Public domain

checks.lead: Tự Đức (Hanoi: [tɯ̂ ɗɯ́k], chữ Hán: 嗣德, lit. 'inheritance of virtues', 22 September 1829 – 19 July 1883) (personal name: Nguyễn Phúc Hồng Nhậm, also Nguyễn Phúc Thì) was the fourth emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty of Vietnam, and the country's last pre-colonial monarch. Ruling for about 36 years from 1847 to 1883, this made him the longest reigning Nguyễn emperor.
